_comment: Fixed Agency baseline data, converted from agency_baseline.properties (2026-08-23 refactor).
Every value is synthetic and non-sensitive (ProjectContext PO-4).
country/state/city: the Add Agency form derives Country from the selected Branch and it is
readonly (verified live 2026-08-18); this value must match what the fixture Branch resolves to.
invoiceGeneration is lower-case 'monthly' on purpose -- this dropdown's own live option text
renders 'BiWeekly'/'annually'/'monthly', inconsistent casing on the application's part.
paymentOption is 'Cash': of this form's 29 Payment option checkboxes, only Cash/Wallet/CreditCard
name a real payment method (FINDING-011); the other 26 are personal names, a data-pollution issue.
contractStartDate/contractEndDate are dd/MM/yyyy, fixed rather than computed from today's date so
knownApprovedBranch is the one already-created, already-approved Branch every Agency fixture is
built beneath (operator instruction, 2026-08-20) -- read-only: never created, edited, or
